Lynch & Associates IN purchased a new position in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) during the 3rd quarter, according to its most recent Form 13F filing with the SEC. The fund purchased 1,267 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock, valued at approximately $286,000.
A number of other large investors have also modified their holdings of the business. Visionary Asset Management Inc. raised its holdings in shares of Apple by 47.4% in the 3rd quarter. Visionary Asset Management Inc. now owns 3,141 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $709,000 after purchasing an additional 1,010 shares during the period. Boenning & Scattergood Inc. raised its holdings in shares of Apple by 7.4% in the 3rd quarter. Boenning & Scattergood Inc. now owns 44,472 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $10,040,000 after purchasing an additional 3,075 shares during the period. CHURCHILL MANAGEMENT Corp raised its holdings in shares of Apple by 7.0% in the 3rd quarter. CHURCHILL MANAGEMENT Corp now owns 61,678 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $13,923,000 after purchasing an additional 4,009 shares during the period. Jaffetilchin Investment Partners LLC raised its holdings in shares of Apple by 2.3% in the 3rd quarter. Jaffetilchin Investment Partners LLC now owns 43,586 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $9,839,000 after purchasing an additional 983 shares during the period. Finally, Windsor Group LTD raised its holdings in shares of Apple by 3.7% in the 3rd quarter. Windsor Group LTD now owns 14,179 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $3,201,000 after purchasing an additional 506 shares during the period. 57.08% of the stock is currently owned by hedge funds and other institutional investors. In other Apple news, insider Chris Kondo sold 3,408 shares of the stock in a transaction that occurred on Monday, November 19th. The shares were sold at an average price of $190.00, for a total transaction of $647,520.00. Following the transaction, the insider now owns 8,940 shares in the company, valued at approximately $1,698,600. The sale was disclosed in a document filed with the SEC, which is accessible through the SEC website . Also, insider Luca Maestri sold 100,245 shares of the stock in a transaction that occurred on Thursday, October 4th. The stock was sold at an average price of $228.56, for a total transaction of $22,911,997.20. Following the transaction, the insider now owns 91,665 shares in the company, valued at approximately $20,950,952.40. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . In the last 90 days, insiders have sold 204,845 shares of company stock worth $47,015,677. Company insiders own 0.06% of the company’s stock.
A number of brokerages have recently issued reports on AAPL. Wells Fargo & Co set a $210.00 target price on shares of Apple and gave the company a “neutral” rating in a report on Monday, October 1st. Oppenheimer reaffirmed a “neutral” rating on shares of Apple in a report on Monday, October 1st. DA Davidson reaffirmed a “buy” rating and issued a $265.00 target price (up from $230.00) on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, September 5th. Morgan Stanley reaffirmed a “buy” rating and issued a $245.00 target price (up from $232.00) on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, September 5th. Finally, Cascend Securities upped their target price on shares of Apple from $230.00 to $250.00 and gave the company a “buy” rating in a report on Tuesday, September 4th. Three research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-three have given a hold rating and twenty-four have given a buy rating to the company’s stock. The stock currently has an average rating of “Hold” and an average price target of $221.36.
Shares of NASDAQ:AAPL opened at $150.73 on Monday. Apple Inc. has a 12-month low of $149.63 and a 12-month high of $233.47. The company has a market cap of $770.84 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 12.66, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.16 and a beta of 1.20. The company has a current ratio of 1.12, a quick ratio of 1.09 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its earnings results on Thursday, November 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.91 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, topping the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $2.78 by $0.13. Apple had a net margin of 22.41% and a return on equity of 48.68%. The firm had revenue of $62.90 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $61.55 billion. During the same quarter in the prior year, the business posted $2.07 EPS. The business’s revenue was up 19.6% compared to the same quarter last year. Equities analysts expect that Apple Inc. will post 13.15 earnings per share for the current fiscal year. About Apple
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers. It also sells various related software, services, accessories, and third-party digital content and applications. The company offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers, as well as iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS operating systems.
